TC_R01.title: Paimon's Cheer
TC_R01.description: Double element combo rewards. Exclusive to the Traveler; duplicate copies do not stack.
TC_R01.flavor: The best travel companion makes every elemental flourish count twice.
TC_R02.title: Journey Compass
TC_R02.description: Raise the element combo limit to [blue]4[/blue] per turn. After your [blue]third[/blue] actual combo reward each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this combat. Does not draw cards.
TC_R02.flavor: Every journey starts with the next step.
TC_R03.title: Unbound Compass
TC_R03.description: Replaces Journey Compass. Whenever an Elemental Combo reward is actually granted, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card. No per-turn trigger limit or turn cooldown. The shared cap of [blue]4[/blue] combos per player per turn is unchanged. Once per turn, when you trigger your [blue]3rd[/blue] Elemental Combo (spending a combo use), gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] for this combat.
TC_R03.flavor: Every resonance points the way onward.
TC_R04.title: Traveler Medicine Chest
TC_R04.description: The first time each turn you Exhaust a Status or Curse, gain 5 Block.
TC_R06.title: Expedition Drum
TC_R06.description: After your third actual combo reward each turn, your next manually played single-target Attack this turn deals +8 base damage on its first hit.
TC_R07.title: Statue Blessing
TC_R07.description: The first time you trigger an elemental combo each combat, gain 6 Plating.
TC_R05.title: Tricolor Prism
TC_R05.description: The first card you play each turn (including autoplay) gains a random element for this combat, replacing its previous element. Replays do not reroll.
TC_R08.title: Wall-Piercing Nail
TC_R08.description: The first Stone-Lightning follow-up hit each turn applies 1 Vulnerable to its target.
TC_R08.flavor: Walls are thinner than they look. So is the outermost one.
TC_R09.title: Echo Spool
TC_R09.description: Your first actual Wind-Stone reward each turn applies 1 Weak to a random living enemy.
TC_R09.flavor: Tie it securely. Last time, only a shadow returned.
TC_R10.title: Reverse Watch
TC_R10.description: Increase your combo limit by 1 each turn: 4 normally, 5 with either compass. Does not accumulate.
TC_R10.flavor: You have another chance. It says that every time.
TC_R11.title: Outside Letter
TC_R11.description: Lose 2 HP at each combat start. Heal 3 HP after first receiving all three different combo rewards in that combat, across any turns.
TC_R12.title: Address Correction
TC_R12.description: At each combat start, add a random unupgraded elemental Traveler reward card to hand with Ethereal, free this turn. Draw 1 fewer card on turn 1. The card lasts for this combat.
TC_R13.title: Unclaimed Mail
TC_R13.description: Normal combat card rewards have 1 extra option. Taking a card costs 15 Gold; insufficient Gold prevents taking it. Skipping grants 10 Gold.
TC_R13.flavor: Every returned letter bears your name.
TC_R14.title: Outside Letter
TC_R15.title: Address Correction
TC_R14.description: Lose 2 HP at the start of each combat. Heal 3 HP at the end of your third turn, once per combat.
TC_R15.description: Draw 1 fewer card on the first turn of each combat. Add a random unupgraded non-Rare reward card for your character to your hand, Ethereal and free this turn. It is not added to your deck. Excludes X-cost and Unplayable cards. Normal cost returns on later turns.
